risks.title: Provider calls leak to browser or tests
risks.impact: Secrets or quota could be exposed if frontend code calls OpenRouter directly or tests use live provider endpoints.
risks.mitigation: Keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY only in backend config, expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to frontend, mock all provider behavior in backend tests, and assert Playwright makes no OpenRouter request.

risks.title: Streaming persistence creates partial assistant messages
risks.impact: Interrupted provider streams could corrupt chat history by storing incomplete assistant responses.
risks.mitigation: Persist the user message before streaming, accumulate assistant deltas in memory, persist the assistant message only after provider completion, emit an SSE error on interruption, and test the failure path.

risks.title: SQLite transaction held across provider latency
risks.impact: Long provider calls can lock local persistence and create brittle timeout behavior.
risks.mitigation: Use short DB operations before and after provider calls, never hold a SQLite transaction while awaiting OpenRouter, and cover the ordering with persistence tests.

risks.title: Frontend and backend contracts drift
risks.impact: The UI may fail at runtime if zod schemas do not match backend response and error shapes.
risks.mitigation: Implement zod schemas from the backend DTO/error contracts, add malformed-response tests, and keep mocked Playwright fixtures aligned with those schemas.

tasks.title: Scaffold backend runtime
tasks.objective: Create the Rust 2024 Axum backend crate with config defaults, tracing, CORS, router assembly, and health endpoint.
context: backend/ is the only server-side API surface
OPENROUTER_MODEL defaults to nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free
No OpenRouter call is needed for health
acceptance_criteria: Rust crate uses edition 2024 and builds as a backend service
GET /health returns service status without requiring OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Config applies the required default OPENROUTER_MODEL
CORS origin is configurable and tracing initializes without panics
risk_notes: Keep local .env loading runtime-only and do not commit secrets

tasks.title: Add SQLite persistence and conversation routes
tasks.objective: Implement sqlx SQLite migrations, pool setup, conversation/message models, and DB-backed conversation/message read routes.
context: SQLite is single-user local persistence
Tables are conversations and messages with UUID text IDs and UTC timestamp text
Conversation deletion should cascade to messages
acceptance_criteria: Runtime migrations create usable conversations and messages tables
Conversation create/list and message list endpoints persist and return expected DTOs
Malformed IDs return 400 validation_error and missing conversations return 404 conversation_not_found
JSON errors use the { error: { code, message, details } } shape
risk_notes: Use runtime sqlx queries to avoid requiring a prepared database

tasks.title: Implement non-streaming provider proxy
tasks.objective: Add the ChatProvider trait, OpenRouter non-streaming implementation, mocked provider tests, and POST message endpoint persistence.
context: OpenRouter calls must remain server-side
Chat send inserts the user message, calls provider outside a DB transaction, then inserts the assistant response after success
Provider failures need stable status codes and error codes
acceptance_criteria: Mocked provider success persists exactly one user and one assistant message
Missing key maps to 503 provider_not_configured
Rate limit maps to 429 provider_rate_limited
Timeout maps to 504 provider_timeout
Invalid provider payload maps to 502 provider_invalid_response
No automated test requires a real OpenRouter API key
risk_notes: Do not hold a SQLite transaction while awaiting provider responses

tasks.title: Implement SSE streaming message endpoint
tasks.objective: Add POST /api/conversations/:conversation_id/messages/stream with native SSE forwarding, assistant accumulation, completion persistence, and interrupted-stream handling.
context: Streaming endpoint forwards model deltas as SSE
Assistant text is persisted only after provider stream completion
Interrupted streams emit SSE error and avoid partial assistant persistence
acceptance_criteria: Streaming success emits assistant delta events and persists the completed assistant message
Interrupted stream emits an SSE error event and does not persist partial assistant text
Malformed stream requests reuse validation_error behavior
Provider stream tests use mocks rather than OpenRouter quota
risk_notes: Client disconnect behavior must not crash the Axum server

tasks.title: Scaffold frontend app and validated API client
tasks.objective: Create the Next.js App Router TypeScript Tailwind frontend with TanStack Query provider, zod schemas, backend client, and test harness.
context: Frontend uses only backend APIs
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is safe to expose
API responses must be validated with zod
acceptance_criteria: Next.js App Router TypeScript project starts and builds with Tailwind configured
TanStack Query provider wraps the app
API client validates conversation, message, and error responses with zod
Malformed backend responses surface as app errors
risk_notes: Keep browser-exposed environment variables limited to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL

tasks.title: Build responsive ChatGPT-style UI
tasks.objective: Implement the conversation sidebar, transcript, markdown assistant rendering, composer, loading states, error banner, and responsive mobile drawer behavior.
context: UI should present the actual chat application as the first screen
Assistant markdown uses react-markdown and remark-gfm
Components must avoid overlap on mobile and desktop
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar can list, create, select, and reflect active conversations
Composer blocks empty input and disables while sending
Transcript renders user and assistant messages with GFM markdown support
Unsafe raw HTML/script content is not rendered as executable markup
Mobile drawer behavior is covered by component tests
risk_notes: Use stable responsive dimensions so dynamic text and loading states do not shift layout unexpectedly

tasks.title: Connect frontend streaming send flow
tasks.objective: Implement native fetch SSE consumption for sending chat messages, optimistic/loading UI behavior, TanStack Query invalidation, and visible error recovery.
context: Streaming fetch is native browser fetch, not EventSource, because the send path is POST
Frontend should consume backend SSE only
Provider/backend/validation errors must be visible to the user
acceptance_criteria: Sending a message consumes mocked SSE deltas and displays assistant output
Conversation/message queries invalidate or update after send completion
Validation/provider/backend errors re-enable composer and surface a useful error state
Frontend code contains no OpenRouter API endpoint or key usage
risk_notes: Align SSE parser expectations with backend event names and payload shape

tasks.title: Add Playwright mocked smoke coverage
tasks.objective: Add a Playwright smoke test that mocks backend network calls, sends one message, consumes mocked SSE, displays assistant output, and asserts no OpenRouter request occurs.
context: Playwright should not require the Rust server or a live provider
Smoke coverage should exercise the user-facing send flow
acceptance_criteria: Playwright test mocks conversations, messages, and streaming send responses
Smoke flow displays the mocked assistant response after send
Test fails if the browser requests an OpenRouter URL
E2E command is exposed as npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e
risk_notes: Avoid introducing test reports or browser artifacts into tracked files

tasks.title: Add docs and environment hygiene
tasks.objective: Write README setup/verification instructions, placeholder-only .env.example, and ignore rules for local env files and generated artifacts.
context: Root docs must explain backend and frontend commands
.env.example must contain placeholders only
Generated DB/build/test artifacts must remain untracked
acceptance_criteria: README documents backend, frontend, test, and local environment setup commands
.env.example uses placeholder values only and documents OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL, and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL
.gitignore excludes .env, generated databases, backend target, frontend .next, node_modules, Playwright reports, and test results
verification_commands: git ls-files backend/target frontend/.next frontend/node_modules frontend/playwright-report frontend/test-results .codedungeon/codedungeon.db
risk_notes: Secret scan should return no tracked real key matches

tasks.title: Run integrated verification and close gaps
tasks.objective: Run the full backend, frontend, e2e, secret, and generated-artifact verification suite; fix only issues needed for the planned scope.
context: Final completion requires verification PASS and CodeDungeon review/finalization evidence
Automated tests must not call OpenRouter
Do not merge; keep workflow PR-centered
acceptance_criteria: Backend fmt, clippy, and tests pass
Frontend lint, component tests, build, and Playwright smoke pass
Secret scan finds no tracked OpenRouter key
Generated-artifact scan finds no tracked build/test/db outputs
Any fixes remain inside the planned backend/frontend/docs hygiene scope
verification_commands: git ls-files backend/target frontend/.next frontend/node_modules frontend/playwright-report frontend/test-results .codedungeon/codedungeon.db
risk_notes: Treat verification failures as implementation gaps, not as reasons to weaken tests

proposals.title: Backend domain foundation
proposals.summary: Create the Rust 2024 Axum service around explicit modules for config, database, DTOs, provider abstraction, structured errors, routes, tracing, CORS, and server startup. Keep sqlx usage runtime-oriented so the generated repo does not need prepared sqlx metadata.

proposals.title: Provider-safe chat contracts
proposals.summary: Put all OpenRouter behavior behind a mockable ChatProvider boundary. Non-streaming chat should persist the user message, call the provider outside database transactions, then persist the assistant response only after success. proposals.title: SQLite conversation model
proposals.summary: Use conversations and messages tables with UUID text IDs, UTC timestamp text, role checks, conversation cascade delete, and message lookup indexing. Conversation and message APIs should return stable DTOs that the frontend can validate with zod.

proposals.title: Frontend application domain

proposals.title: Mock-first verification domain
proposals.summary: Prove backend and frontend behavior with deterministic local tests. Backend tests should mock provider success and failure states. Frontend tests should mock backend responses. Playwright smoke should mock API and streaming calls and assert the browser never requests OpenRouter.

proposals.title: Documentation and secret hygiene
proposals.summary: Keep .env ignored, .env.example placeholder-only, and README commands aligned with the actual backend and frontend scripts. Include final scans for real OpenRouter keys and generated build, test, dependency, and database artifacts.

risks.title: OpenRouter leaks into browser or tests
risks.impact: Client-side provider calls or automated live provider calls would violate project rules, expose sensitive configuration, and make verification non-deterministic.
risks.mitigation: Assign OpenRouter ownership exclusively to backend provider code, use provider mocks in backend tests, mock backend routes in frontend tests, and add Playwright assertions that no browser request targets OpenRouter.

risks.title: Partial assistant messages are persisted after stream interruption
risks.impact: Conversation history could contain incomplete or misleading assistant content after timeout, provider interruption, or client disconnect.
risks.mitigation: Accumulate stream deltas outside the database and insert the assistant message only after stream completion; add tests proving interrupted streams emit an error and do not persist partial assistant rows.

risks.title: Backend and frontend schemas drift
risks.impact: The UI may silently mishandle validation, provider, malformed response, or SSE errors if backend response shapes and frontend zod schemas diverge.
risks.mitigation: Stabilize backend DTO and error contracts before frontend integration, mirror them in zod schemas, and test malformed response handling and app error states.

risks.title: SQLite transaction scope includes provider calls
risks.impact: Long provider calls inside database transactions can cause lock contention and brittle streaming behavior.
risks.mitigation: Persist user messages before provider calls, release DB work while waiting on OpenRouter, and persist assistant messages only after provider success.

risks.title: Generated artifacts or local secrets become tracked
risks.impact: Tracked databases, build outputs, node_modules, test reports, or real OpenRouter keys would block final approval.
risks.mitigation: Add root hygiene early and require final git grep and git ls-files checks for secrets and generated artifacts.

risks.title: Automated tests call real OpenRouter

risks.title: Backend and frontend response contracts drift

risks.title: Markdown rendering introduces unsafe raw HTML behavior
risks.impact: Assistant content could render executable or misleading markup in the browser.
risks.mitigation: Use react-markdown without rehype-raw, add tests for raw script or HTML content, and render code/GFM through safe components only.

risks.title: CORS is either too open or breaks local frontend development
risks.impact: Overly broad CORS weakens the proxy boundary, while overly narrow CORS prevents the Next.js app from calling the backend.
risks.mitigation: Make frontend origin configurable, default to the documented local origin, and test allowed origin behavior.

The graph keeps OpenRouter server-side, requires mocked provider tests, preserves SQLite/sqlx persistence, and sequences streaming and Playwright work after stable backend/frontend contracts.

proposals.title: Root hygiene and documented local workflow
proposals.summary: Prepare repository-level ignore rules, placeholder-only environment examples, and README command guidance without secrets or generated artifacts.

proposals.title: Backend Axum SQLite OpenRouter service
proposals.summary: Build a Rust 2024 Axum backend with sqlx SQLite migrations, structured validation/errors, CORS/tracing, OpenRouter provider abstraction, JSON chat endpoints, SSE streaming, and mocked tests.

proposals.title: Frontend ChatGPT-style Next.js client
proposals.summary: Build a Next.js App Router TypeScript Tailwind frontend with zod-validated API client, TanStack Query state, markdown transcript UI, native streaming fetch, component tests, and mocked Playwright smoke coverage.

proposals.title: Final verification and artifact hygiene
proposals.summary: Run backend/frontend verification commands, Playwright smoke, secret scans, and generated-artifact checks before final CodeDungeon reporting.

risks.title: OpenRouter leakage into browser or tracked files
risks.impact: Exposes provider credentials or violates the server-side proxy boundary.
risks.mitigation: Keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY only in backend runtime config, expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to the frontend, keep .env ignored, and run a tracked-file secret scan before completion.

risks.title: Streaming persistence can save partial assistant output
risks.impact: Interrupted or malformed provider streams could corrupt conversation history.
risks.mitigation: Persist the user message before provider streaming, accumulate assistant deltas in memory, persist the assistant message only after stream completion, and test interrupted stream behavior with mocks.

risks.title: Backend and frontend response schemas drift
risks.impact: The UI may pass tests against stale mocks while failing against the Axum API.
risks.mitigation: Stabilize backend DTOs before frontend integration, mirror them in zod schemas, and include malformed-response tests.

risks.title: Automated tests accidentally call external OpenRouter
risks.impact: Tests become flaky, consume quota, or require local secrets.
risks.mitigation: Inject ChatProvider mocks in backend tests and mock all browser network calls in component and Playwright tests.

claims.title: Use parallel foundation tracks
claims.summary: Root docs, backend scaffold, and frontend scaffold can start independently because they own separate paths and establish contracts for later waves.

claims.title: Separate backend streaming from JSON chat
claims.summary: The JSON send endpoint should land before SSE so persistence, provider mapping, and test fixtures are stable for the more failure-prone streaming path.

claims.title: Provider access is server-only
claims.summary: All OpenRouter configuration and HTTP calls stay under backend/, and frontend tests must assert no browser request targets OpenRouter.

claims.title: Final completion depends on verification evidence
claims.summary: Completion should not be reported until backend commands, frontend commands, Playwright smoke, secret scan, and generated-artifact checks have passing evidence.

tasks.title: Prepare root hygiene files
tasks.objective: Create or update root project hygiene for placeholders, ignored secrets, ignored generated outputs, and high-level development commands.
context: PROJECT_RULES_STATUS: approved
PROJECT_RULES_DIGEST: 62b79626958677deaa3fd0d932f147920ee8a93f3de3d5f5fa283023aaf20d6b
PROJECT_RULES_READ: yes
.env must remain ignored and .env.example must contain placeholders only
Generated databases, build outputs, node_modules, and test reports must not be tracked
acceptance_criteria: .env.example documents OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL, backend settings, and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL using placeholder values only
.gitignore excludes .env, backend build/database outputs, frontend node_modules/.next, and Playwright reports
README lists backend and frontend setup and verification commands without claiming final completion
risk_notes: Do not copy local values from .env into tracked files

tasks.title: Scaffold backend crate, config, database, health, tracing, and CORS
tasks.objective: Create the Rust 2024 Axum backend foundation with runtime config defaults, SQLite pool/migrations, router assembly, health endpoint, tracing, and CORS setup.
context: Backend must live in backend/
Use Rust 2024, Tokio, Axum, SQLite/sqlx, dotenvy, tracing, and tower-http CORS
OPENROUTER_MODEL defaults to nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free
Health must not require a real OpenRouter key
acceptance_criteria: Backend crate builds as Rust edition 2024
SQLite migrations create conversations and messages tables with UUID text IDs, UTC text timestamps, role checks, cascade delete, and message lookup index
Config loads local .env at runtime and defaults OPENROUTER_MODEL when unset
GET /health returns service status without provider access
CORS is configurable for the frontend origin
risk_notes: Use runtime sqlx queries rather than compile-time macros that require a prepared database

tasks.title: Scaffold frontend app, styling, validation, query, and test tooling
tasks.objective: Create the Next.js App Router TypeScript Tailwind frontend foundation with test runners and dependencies needed for the chat UI.
context: Frontend must live in frontend/
Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, zod, TanStack Query, react-markdown, remark-gfm, component tests, and Playwright
Browser code talks only to the backend API base URL
acceptance_criteria: Next.js app renders a minimal App Router page
Tailwind and global styles are wired
TanStack Query provider is available to client components
Component test and Playwright scripts exist in package.json
No OpenRouter URL or key is exposed in frontend code
risk_notes: Do not introduce NEXT_PUBLIC OpenRouter configuration

tasks.title: Implement backend models, validation, errors, and repository functions
tasks.objective: Add typed conversation/message models, shared validation/error response mapping, and SQLite repository operations with focused tests.
context: Error JSON shape is { error: { code, message, details } }
Reject empty, whitespace-only, oversized content, malformed IDs, and missing conversations
Use DB-only operations for create/list/load
acceptance_criteria: Repository can create, list, and load conversations
Repository can insert and list messages in conversation order
Validation produces stable error codes for malformed IDs and invalid content
Missing conversation maps to conversation_not_found
Tests use temporary SQLite databases and run without OpenRouter
risk_notes: Keep database operations independent from provider calls

tasks.title: Implement backend conversation and message JSON routes
tasks.objective: Expose conversation list/create, message list, and request validation routes over Axum using the repository and structured errors.
context: GET /api/conversations
POST /api/conversations with optional title
GET /api/conversations/:conversation_id/messages
JSON endpoints return structured errors
acceptance_criteria: Conversation create/list endpoints persist and return typed DTOs
Message list returns messages for an existing conversation
Malformed and missing conversation IDs return documented status codes and error codes
Route tests run with in-memory or temporary SQLite and no provider
risk_notes: Avoid changing provider or streaming code in this task

tasks.title: Implement OpenRouter provider abstraction and non-streaming client
tasks.objective: Add a mockable ChatProvider trait, OpenRouter request/response client, provider error taxonomy, and tests for server-side failure mapping.
context: OpenRouter calls must remain server-side
Provider failures include missing key, rate limit, timeout, and invalid response
Automated tests must use mocks or local fake HTTP and never real OpenRouter quota
acceptance_criteria: ChatProvider trait supports non-streaming completion calls
OpenRouter implementation reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_MODEL only from backend runtime config
Missing key maps to 503 provider_not_configured
429 maps to provider_rate_limited, timeout maps to provider_timeout, invalid payload maps to provider_invalid_response
Provider tests do not require external network or provider credentials
risk_notes: Do not add provider secrets to logs or frontend-facing responses

tasks.title: Implement backend non-streaming chat send endpoint
tasks.objective: Add POST /api/conversations/:conversation_id/messages that persists user input, calls the provider outside a database transaction, persists assistant output on success, and maps failures.
context: Non-streaming send inserts user message before provider call
Provider call must not hold a SQLite transaction
Assistant message persists only after provider success
Provider tests use injected mocks
acceptance_criteria: Successful mocked send persists exactly one user message and one assistant message
Provider failures return documented status and error codes
Validation failures do not call the provider
Missing conversations return 404 conversation_not_found
Tests prove provider is mocked
risk_notes: User message persistence before provider failure is acceptable; incomplete assistant persistence is not

tasks.title: Implement backend SSE streaming chat endpoint
tasks.objective: Add POST /api/conversations/:conversation_id/messages/stream that forwards provider deltas as SSE and persists assistant output only after a complete stream.
context: Streaming endpoint uses native SSE events
Interrupted streams emit SSE error and do not persist partial assistant output
OpenRouter stream errors must not crash the server
Tests must mock provider streams
acceptance_criteria: Streaming success emits assistant delta SSE events and a completion event
Assistant message is persisted only after provider stream completion
Interrupted provider stream emits an error event and leaves no partial assistant message
Rate limit, timeout, and invalid stream payload failures are handled explicitly
Streaming tests run without external provider calls
risk_notes: Take care that client disconnects and provider stream errors do not leave partial assistant messages

tasks.title: Implement frontend zod API client and TanStack Query hooks
tasks.objective: Create a typed browser API layer that validates backend JSON responses and provides conversation/message query and mutation hooks.
context: Frontend talks only to backend API base URL
zod validation failures become user-visible app errors
TanStack Query owns conversation/message cache and invalidation
acceptance_criteria: API client validates conversations, messages, and structured backend errors with zod
Malformed backend responses are rejected and surfaced as app errors
Conversation create/list and message list hooks invalidate or refresh expected caches
No frontend code references OpenRouter domains, keys, or models
risk_notes: Keep DTO names aligned with backend route contracts before shell integration

tasks.title: Implement frontend chat UI components
tasks.objective: Build reusable ChatGPT-style sidebar, transcript, composer, and error/loading UI components with focused component tests.
context: UI should feel like a working chat app, not a landing page
Transcript renders assistant markdown with react-markdown and remark-gfm
Composer blocks empty input and disables while sending
Sidebar supports selected state and mobile drawer behavior
acceptance_criteria: Composer rejects empty and whitespace-only messages
Composer exposes disabled/loading states
Transcript renders GFM tables/code and does not execute raw HTML/script markup
Sidebar can create/select conversations and supports mobile drawer state in tests
Text and controls do not overlap in common desktop and mobile layouts
risk_notes: Avoid decorative one-note layouts; prioritize dense, usable chat workflow

tasks.title: Wire frontend page state to API hooks
tasks.objective: Connect the App Router page to query hooks and UI components so users can list/create/select conversations and view messages through mocked backend responses.
context: This task wires non-streaming state only
Streaming send integration is a later task
API calls are mocked in tests
acceptance_criteria: Initial page loads conversations and selects an active conversation when available
Create conversation action updates sidebar and active state
Message transcript updates from query data
Backend and validation errors show a visible error state
Tests mock backend responses and do not require the Rust server
risk_notes: Avoid duplicating server state outside TanStack Query except transient UI input state

tasks.title: Implement frontend native streaming send and Playwright smoke
tasks.objective: Add native fetch SSE message sending, optimistic transcript updates, cache reconciliation, and a mocked Playwright smoke flow.
context: Streaming endpoint is POST /api/conversations/:conversation_id/messages/stream
Use native browser fetch for streaming
Playwright must mock backend network calls and assert no OpenRouter request is made
acceptance_criteria: Sending a message consumes mocked SSE deltas and displays assistant output incrementally or after completion
Composer disables during streaming and re-enables after success or error
Stream errors surface an app error without losing existing conversation history
Playwright smoke mocks conversations, messages, and streaming send
Playwright asserts the browser does not request OpenRouter
risk_notes: SSE parser must tolerate chunk boundaries and preserve user-visible errors

tasks.title: Update README and environment docs against implemented commands
tasks.objective: Reconcile README and .env.example with the final backend/frontend command set and runtime configuration after implementation.
context: Docs must remain placeholder-only for secrets
README should document local backend/frontend startup, tests, and streaming behavior at a practical level
Do not claim CodeDungeon final completion in README
acceptance_criteria: README commands match actual package and cargo scripts
.env.example remains placeholder-only and includes OPENROUTER_MODEL default guidance
Docs explain that automated tests use mocks and do not call OpenRouter
Docs note backend-only OpenRouter proxying
risk_notes: Documentation drift can cause final verification commands to be misleading

tasks.title: Run final QA verification and hygiene scans
tasks.objective: Execute the required backend/frontend verification, Playwright smoke, secret scan, generated-artifact scan, and capture failures for follow-up fixes.
context: Final completion requires verification PASS and approved standalone review evidence
This task verifies but does not merge
No automated check should call external OpenRouter
acceptance_criteria: cargo fmt check passes for backend
cargo clippy passes for backend with -D warnings
cargo test passes for backend
frontend lint, component tests, build, and Playwright smoke pass
Tracked files contain no real OpenRouter keys
Generated databases, build outputs, node_modules, and test reports are not tracked
verification_commands: if (git ls-files backend/target frontend/.next frontend/node_modules frontend/playwright-report frontend/test-results .codedungeon/codedungeon.db) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }
risk_notes: If verification fails, create targeted fix tasks instead of weakening checks
